title: Reinforcement learning with an expectile-based objective
abstract: arXiv:2602.09300v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider the policy evaluation and control in a finite horizon reinforcement learning (RL) setting under an expectile-based objective. First, we derive the mean-squared error (MSE) and concentration bounds for the classic estimator of expectiles based on independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples. To the best of our knowledge, expectiles have not been analyzed in the non-asymptotic regime and the bounds we derive may be of independent interest. Next, we analyze a Monte Carlo type estimator of expectile of the Markov chain underlying a given policy. We derive upper bounds that hold in expectation as well as with high probability for this estimator. Further, we show the order-optimality of our estimator by deriving a lower bound on expectile-based policy evaluation. translated_title: 基于期望分位目标的强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们在有限时域强化学习（RL）设定下，研究基于期望分位目标的策略评估与控制问题。首先，我们针对基于独立同分布（i.i.d.）样本的经典期望分位估计量，推导了其均方误差（MSE）界和集中不等式界。据我们所知，期望分位此前尚未在非渐近情形下被分析过，因此我们所推导的界可能具有独立的研究价值。接下来，我们分析了给定策略所对应的马尔可夫链的期望分位的蒙特卡洛型估计量，并推导了该估计量在期望意义下以及高概率意义下均成立的上界。此外，我们通过推导基于期望分位的策略评估问题的下界，证明了我们所提出估计量的阶最优性。对于控制问题，我们采用策略梯度方法，推导了期望分位的策略梯度定理。利用这一结果，我们提出了一种梯度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次对期望分位估计进行了非渐近分析，证明了蒙特卡洛型期望分位策略评估估计量的阶最优性，并推导了期望分位的策略梯度定理以解决控制问题。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first non-asymptotic analysis of expectile estimation, establishes the order-optimality of a Monte Carlo estimator for expectile-based policy evaluation, and derives a policy gradient theorem for expectile-based control.
